answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.938, which sits at the top of the fine-tuned range (0.900-0.938) and above quantized (0.945-0.955) and system-prompted (0.861-0.908). Sequence agreement of 0.562 fits fine-tuned (0.47-0.64), since quantized is 0.67-0.70 and system-prompted is 0.31-0.48. The Token-DiFR gap of 0.226 fits fine-tuned (0.10-0.31) and is too large for quantized (0.03-0.04). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 11.5 is slightly above the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) but far outside quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9). TV of 0.076 matches the bottom of the fine-tuned range. KL of 0.071 overlaps both quantized and fine-tuned. Quantized is the closest alternative, but the DiFR gap and the raw-score ratio rule it out. All values are non-zero, so it is not base.
